content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Dr YSR Horticultural University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Dr YSR Horticultural University for various positions on an outsourcing basis at Kovvur.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The vacancies include Electrician, Record Assistant, Mali/Gardiner, and Sanitary Attender positions across different categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available for various posts under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly Walk-in. Eligible candidates directly attend the interview at the designated venue on the specified date.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Dr YSR Horticultural University recruitment is scheduled to be held on 13 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Electrician post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Electrician post must possess an ITI (Electrical) qualification from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for the Record Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Record Assistant post must have passed SSC or an equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q8. What are the requirements for Mali/Gardiner and Sanitary Attender posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Mali/Gardiner and Sanitary Attender posts should be able to read and write any one of the regional languages.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a duly filled application form, passport-size photographs, all original certificates for verification, and one set of attested photocopies of certificates.
